Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

Our third-party integration partner required additional time to complete their certification process, and this has pushed the project timeline back by two weeks. The certification step is now complete, and our team is proceeding with the remaining work on that basis.

The new delivery date is 14 April. We have reviewed the remaining milestones with this date in mind and are confident it reflects an achievable and stable schedule for the rest of the project.

Does 14 April work on your end, or are there any downstream commitments on your side we should factor into our final rollout plan? We will continue to keep you updated on our progress and are happy to walk through the revised schedule in more detail at your convenience.
